description:
I'm Yasmeen, an Industrial Design student from Egypt. I'm passionate about innovation, sustainability, technology, and human-centered design.

I have experience in 3D modeling, design research, and creative problem-solving, using tools like Rhino, Blender, and Adobe Illustrator.

I'm looking for creative, dedicated teammates with backgrounds in engineering, programming, AI, or scientific research. I believe in teamwork, exchanging ideas, and combining different skills to make impactful solutions
